reason: Round 5 (Codex P1-2): reply and mandatory effect commit in one transaction on every entry route. Every test now ends with the invariant check (no answered request of a workflow root without its applied effect); the reconcile test states that it models a PREVIOUS build (reply alone, then reconcile) and checks the helper flags that state before repair. No assertion weakened; atomicity counter-examples live in tests.test_wf_answer_atomicity.
